title: CSCI 320 — Principles of Data Management
subject: Cybersecurity
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the core components of the relational database model, including entities, attributes, and relationships.
Explain how Structured Query Language (SQL) is used to retrieve, update, and manage relational data.
Apply data quality, transaction integrity, and security principles to design a secure relational database system.
